d:
What happens when Zakir Khan sits down with Team Nayyi Navelli? Expect gupshup, behind-the-scenes stories, unexpected banter and plenty of laughs!
Zakir is joined by Yami Gautam, Aaditya Kulshreshth, Anurag Thakur and producer Anand L. Rai for a candid conversation about their upcoming Dussehra release, Nayyi Navelli.
Watch Nayyi Navelli in theatres near you from 16th October 2026.
